name: image-wallet
title: Image Wallet
description: Store and retrieve images quickly from Raycast!
author: ibll

commands.name: image-wallet
commands.title: Image Wallet
commands.description: Browse and view your saved images.

preferences.name: walletDirectory
preferences.title: Wallet Directory
preferences.description: Path to load Wallet from. Leave blank for default.

preferences.name: thumbnailLayout
preferences.title: Thumbnail Layout
preferences.description: How Card images are laid out inside their grid cell.

data.title: Contain (fill the cell, whole image visible)
Fill (crop to fill the cell edge to edge)

preferences.name: gridColumns
preferences.title: Cards per Row
preferences.description: How many Cards fit across the grid. Fewer columns means larger thumbnails.

preferences.name: videoPreviews
preferences.label: Generate Video Previews
preferences.description:
Should video Cards generate preview images?

Can slow down Wallet when adding videos.
Requires ffmpeg on your PATH on Windows.
Manually reset previews with the Reset Video Previews action.

preferences.name: rememberPocketFilter
preferences.label: Remember Pocket Filter
preferences.description: Should the filtered Pocket be recalled when the Wallet is re-launched?

preferences.name: suppressReadErrors
preferences.label: Suppress Read Errors
preferences.description: Hide the warning when a file or directory could not be read.
